sources.title: Virtual I/O Device (VIRTIO) Version 1.4 Committee Specification 01
sources.finding: Reset completion prohibits further queue interaction until reinitialization for a conforming device; exposed buffers require queue cleanup. This conditional contract does not validate an implementation or persistence.

sources.title: Using Multiple IOThreads
sources.finding: Main-loop and vCPU device execution share BQL serialization. The checked local 11.1.2 source copies, rather than rolling master documentation, determine this experiment.
